item.title: Protest on Las Olas aims to save Fort Lauderdale’s famous trees
item.description: Lose the trees on Las Olas and you lose the charm, critics say. On Monday, protesters gathered to urge the commission to get rid of on-street parking if they want wider sidewalks.
